body: Open the panel to see a paragraph marked up the way a tutor would.

_popup.title: Marking a paragraph
_popup.body:
Read the claim first, then check the support behind it.

Claim: renewable energy is the better choice. Support: one blog post. The problem: the claim reaches further than a single, unverifiable source can carry. Narrow the claim, or find stronger evidence.
